purpose: Auditable public target geometry for NGOFS2 shoreline-cell transport extraction. Coordinates are public landmarks/localities, never private-home coordinates; MODEL guidance only.

targets.coordinate_basis: public USGS/GNIS Montrose locality coordinate; used only as a public starting anchor for westward wet-grid selection and not as the owner-home location
targets.implementation_rule: Selected wet NGOFS2 nodes are public MODEL grid locations near the Montrose shoreline cell; never describe the public locality coordinate as the 437 property coordinate.

targets.coordinate_basis: verified public NOAA Point Clear target

guardrails: Coordinates select MODEL extraction transects; they are not Jubilee event locations.
Do not expose or infer a private owner-home coordinate for regular-grid research.
Select multiple wet grid nodes along each public-anchor offshore transect rather than silently substituting a distant named station.
Preserve exact selected grid-node coordinates, bathymetry, node-to-target distance and extraction cycle in manifests.
Run shoreline-normal sensitivity at plus/minus 15 degrees before assigning production weight.
No transport predictor receives positive production weight without held-out incremental value.
